title: Gator Viewing Clear Kayak Springs Tour
includes: Stand Up Paddleboard or Kayak, Paddle, Life Vest and Leash
$6 per person State Park/launch fee (not included)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: Make sure you are comfortable around water. Let your guide know if you are not a strong swimmer before the tour begins.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This tour offers a rare opportunity to observe Florida’s most iconic wildlife from the unique vantage point of a clear kayak or paddleboard on the Silver River. With exceptional water clarity, you can often see fish and turtles swimming below while alligators rest along the shoreline — all from a safe and respectful distance.

Silver Springs is one of the state’s oldest and most historic natural attractions, home to diverse ecosystems that support gators, turtles, wading birds, manatees (seasonal), and even wild rhesus monkeys. The visibility here is unmatched, creating vivid blues and greens that feel almost unreal.

Unlike standard kayak tours, our transparent vessels provide continuous underwater viewing, adding an entirely new dimension to wildlife observation. Throughout the experience, your knowledgeable guide shares insight into the river’s ecology, history, and conservation, transforming a paddle into a deeper understanding of wild Florida.
